item.description:
• Clearer error when macOS blocks adopting a manually-installed app into Homebrew due to the App Management privacy permission, with a one-click button straight to System Settings
  • Kegwatch no longer offers to "update" a manually-installed app to an older Homebrew cask version — apps that already updated themselves ahead of their cask (e.g. via their own built-in updater) are no longer shown as having an available update
  • The "Manually Installed" section now tells you when it couldn't be scanned (e.g. `brew list --cask` failed) instead of silently disappearing
  • The menu bar badge no longer shows a stale update count after a batch install finishes
